name: Daily OPD Register
query:
SELECT
    a.name AS "Appointment:Link/Appointment:120",
    a.appointment_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    a.appointment_time AS "Time:Time:100",
    p.patient_name AS "Patient:Data:180",
    d.doctor_name AS "Doctor:Data:180",
    a.slot AS "Slot:Data:100",
    a.status AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM
    `tabAppointment` a
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPatient` p ON p.name = a.patient
LEFT JOIN
    `tabDoctor` d ON d.name = a.doctor
WHERE
    a.appointment_date = %(date)s
ORDER BY
    a.appointment_time ASC
